MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.description: Modifier stacking uses TWO separate pools. Prep tasks: condition x RRP x access x masonry_type x texture. Coating tasks: QT x access x masonry_type x texture x coating_system. Condition and RRP NEVER apply to coating tasks. QT NEVER applies to prep tasks.
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_prep: POOR(2.0) x RRP(2.0) x scaffold(1.60) x split_face_cmu(1.30) x rough(1.50) = 12.48x — extreme theoretical
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.realistic_worst_prep: FAIR(1.5) x no_RRP(1.0) x ladder(1.35) x brick(1.00) x medium(1.20) = 2.43x — within cap
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_coating: QT4(1.20) x scaffold(1.60) x split_face_cmu(1.30) x rough(1.50) x elastomeric(1.50) = 5.62x — exceeds 4.0x, recommend T&M
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.realistic_worst_coating: QT3(1.0) x ladder(1.35) x brick(1.00) x medium(1.20) x acrylic(1.00) = 1.62x — comfortable

prep_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (condition x rrp x access x masonry_type x texture)

coating_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (qt x access x masonry_type x texture x coating_system)

fixed_tasks.note: Assessment, equipment setup/cleanup, RRP containment, customer walkthrough.

masonry_surface_input_group.description: Rate per SF applies to net masonry wall field area. RP rates calibrated from NC sibling with RP-specific adjustments. Base rates for brick, smooth texture, ground access. spray_backroll is PRIMARY method.

task_production_rates.name: Landscape Perimeter Protection Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_MSRY_LANDSCAPE_PROTECT (120 LF/hr). Ground-level task. ~30 sec/LF.

task_production_rates.name: Hardscape Protection Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_MSRY_HARDSCAPE_PROTECT (250 SF/hr).

task_production_rates.name: Fixture and Utility Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC (15 EA/hr). ~4 min/fixture.

task_production_rates.name: Vehicle/Driveway Overspray Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Poly sheeting over vehicles/driveway. ~18 sec/SF. spray_backroll only.

task_production_rates.name: Ground Protection — Scraping Debris Containment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Ground cover below work zone. ~18 sec/SF.

task_production_rates.name: Spray/Backroll Equipment Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC (45 min -> 50 min for RP context — staging scraping tools alongside spray equipment).

task_production_rates.name: Brush/Roll Equipment Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC (25 min -> 30 min for RP context).

task_production_rates.name: Visual Condition Inspection Per Elevation
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Per-elevation FIXED. Masonry assessment is more complex than siding (mortar joints, efflorescence, crack types).

task_production_rates.name: Chalk Test (White Cloth Rub)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Per-elevation. ~5 min. Same as FC siding RP.

task_production_rates.name: Adhesion Test (ASTM D3359)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Per-elevation. 2+ locations per elevation. ~10 min.

task_production_rates.name: Efflorescence Scan Per Elevation
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Masonry-specific. Scan for white salt deposits. Distinguish dormant vs active. ~10 min/elevation.

task_production_rates.name: Moisture Test (ASTM D4263) Per Elevation
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Multiple test locations per elevation (base, joints, efflorescence areas, splash zones). ~15 min.

task_production_rates.name: Mortar Joint / Tuck-Point Assessment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Masonry-specific. Evaluate mortar condition. ~10 min/elevation.

task_production_rates.name: Crack Mapping — Structural vs Cosmetic
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Map and classify cracks. ~10 min/elevation.

task_production_rates.name: Power Wash Masonry Surface
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC TSK_MSRY_POWER_WASH (NC 350 SF/hr). RP dual purpose: cleaning + paint removal. QT2=light cleaning 400 SF/hr. QT3=full wash+targeted removal 300 SF/hr. QT4=thorough systematic 250 SF/hr. Condition modifier accounts for more time on FAIR/POOR surfaces.

task_production_rates.name: Efflorescence Neutralization Treatment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Dry brush + acid/TSP treatment + neutralize + rinse. ~36 sec/SF. Applied to affected areas only (not full surface). Limestone uses phosphoric acid/TSP (slower, more careful).

task_production_rates.name: Chalk Remediation Pre-Treatment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Chemical chalk removal on stubborn areas post-wash. ~18 sec/SF. Applied to chalking areas only.

task_production_rates.name: Scrape Failing/Peeling Paint + Feather Edges
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Hand scrape remaining loose paint after power wash + 80-grit feather edges. ~45 sec/SF for affected areas. Less manual scraping needed than wood (power wash handles more on hard substrate). Condition modifier heavy impact.

task_production_rates.name: Crack Filling — Hairline Cracks
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Fill hairline cracks with elastomeric filler. ~1 min/LF. QT3+ only.

task_production_rates.name: Spall/Chip Patching
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Patch individual spalls with cementitious compound. ~10 min/EA. Includes mix, apply, feather edges. QT3+ only.

task_production_rates.name: General Surface Repair
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC (NC 50 SF/hr). Fill voids, blend previous patches. QT3+ only. Applied to affected areas.

task_production_rates.name: Post-Prep Dust and Debris Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Blow down or brush entire surface. ~7 sec/SF. Critical before priming.

task_production_rates.name: Caulk Joint Assessment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Inspect masonry-to-trim joints. ~18 sec/LF. Less scope than siding RP.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Failed Caulk
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Cut and remove failed caulk. ~1.5 min/LF. Applied to failed joints only.

task_production_rates.name: Apply New Caulk
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC TSK_MSRY_CAULK_MASONRY_TRIM (NC 50 LF/hr). ~1.2 min/LF. Polyurethane Class 25/50.

task_production_rates.name: Chalk-Binding Primer — Spray/Backroll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Full surface chalk-binding primer spray_backroll. Calibrated from NC primer rate (400 SF/hr) with 12% reduction for chalk-binding product (thicker body, slower penetration). 2-person crew.

task_production_rates.name: Chalk-Binding Primer — Brush/Roll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Brush/roll chalk-binding primer. ~30 sec/SF. Fallback method.

task_production_rates.name: Alkali-Resistant Spot Prime — Exposed Bare Masonry
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Brush spot prime on bare masonry areas. ~45 sec/SF of bare area. Brush-only regardless of primary method.

task_production_rates.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer — Spray/Backroll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Acrylic stain-block on previously painted masonry. Slightly faster than NC alkali-resistant primer (existing paint reduces absorption). 2-person crew.

task_production_rates.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer — Brush/Roll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Brush/roll acrylic stain-block. Fallback method.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 1 — Spray/Backroll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_MSRY_FINISH_1_SPRAY_BACKROLL (NC 450 SF/hr). RP rate matches NC — previously painted surface has similar coverage to primed surface. 2-person crew. Elastomeric 1.50x modifier reduces to 300 SF/hr effective.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 1 — Brush/Roll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_MSRY_FINISH_1_ROLL (NC 150 SF/hr). Fallback method.

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC (NC QT3=1500, QT4=800 SF/hr). Same rates — inspection technique unchanged.

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Light Sand (QT4 Only)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC (NC 300 SF/hr). 220-grit between finish coats. QT4 only. Texture modifier — rough masonry is harder to sand.

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Touch-Up
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC (NC 600 SF/hr). Brush touch-up of defects. ~6 sec/SF.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 2 — Spray/Backroll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_MSRY_FINISH_2_SPRAY_BACKROLL (NC 450 SF/hr). QT3/QT4 only.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 2 — Brush/Roll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_MSRY_FINISH_2_ROLL (NC 150 SF/hr). QT3/QT4 only.

task_production_rates.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC. Per-elevation FIXED.

task_production_rates.name: Final Touch-Up
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC. Per-elevation FIXED.

task_production_rates.name: Protection Teardown
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC (NC 30 min -> RP 45 min, more zones including vehicle/ground cover).

task_production_rates.name: Equipment Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC (NC 30 min -> RP 40 min, additional scraping tools + acid containers to clean/dispose).

task_production_rates.name: Site Debris Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Collect scraping debris, paint chips, caulk remnants, waste. RP generates more debris than NC.

task_production_rates.name: Customer Walkthrough
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Walk customer through completed work. Occupied home context.

task_production_rates.name: Lead Paint Screening
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: SHARED_RRP. XRF or swab test. Per-elevation. ~20 min.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Containment Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: SHARED_RRP. 6-mil poly 10 ft from structure. Per-elevation. 2-person, ~60 min. Includes power wash water containment (masonry-specific).

task_production_rates.name: RRP Wet Scraping Methods
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: SHARED_RRP. Wet scraping per EPA. ~72 sec/SF. Applied to paint disturbance areas.

task_production_rates.name: HEPA Vacuum Lead Dust Collection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: SHARED_RRP. HEPA vacuum all surfaces. ~18 sec/SF.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Containment Teardown and Disposal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: SHARED_RRP. Remove and dispose contaminated containment. Per-elevation. 2-person, ~45 min.

factor_modifiers.name: Condition Scale — Prep Multiplier
factor_modifiers.description: Drives prep task duration based on surface condition. PREP POOL ONLY.

factor_modifiers.name: RRP Lead-Safe — Prep Multiplier
factor_modifiers.description: 2.0x on prep tasks involving paint disturbance when lead-positive. PREP POOL ONLY.

factor_modifiers.name: Height/Access Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Per-elevation access type. Shared across exterior specs.

factor_modifiers.name: Masonry Type Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Substrate type impact on production rates.

factor_modifiers.name: Surface Texture Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Texture impact on production rates and material consumption.

factor_modifiers.name: Quality Tier Modifier — Coating Tasks
factor_modifiers.description: QT impact on coating task rates. COATING POOL ONLY.

factor_modifiers.name: Coating System Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Elastomeric is 1.50x slower than acrylic (heavier body, thicker application). COATING POOL ONLY.
